MapleStory is a 2D platforming mmorpg. It's a cute anime-esque art style, and the whole 2D aspect for a mmo is totally unique and it works. Sort of gives me the Mabinogi vibes, but easier to understand the how everything works. The controls are also easy to follow and get into. We even had a nice community member join in stream to help us along. We really got lost in playing until my pistol ran out of bullets, and I can see coming back to the game again. And I give this a 7/10.

I honestly wish I could reccomend this relic of an MMO, but it's obviously not what it once used to be. I played it for a little while in 2011-2012, and I can honestly say this is an empty shell of what it used to be even with the little experience I had.

Leveling is a joke, the community is dead and what's left of it is no better, and the game play requires more grinding rather than enjoying the numerous quests and story lines you can play. The pay wall isn't as strong as long as you're smart with how you spend ingame currency and what missions you grind for leveling. It's basically all on you to drop a few bucks on this game for it's cosmetics, just like Team Fortress 2 and Overwatch. Only difference between the games is that Maplestory has plenty of ingame cosmetics you can use that earn through quests and events.

If you want to give maplestory a shot go ahead and give it a try, just be sure to play newer classes since all the older classes are completely wortheless due to how OP all the new classes are.

reason.text: Negative reviews in this period mostly object to monetization, such as paying to grind 6th job and a free server described as pay-to-win.
Reviews also tie this to the 6th job release, which an official announcement from the same period covers.
